title: Continuous rational realization commutes with derived direct image
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the small pro-etale site of $T=X,Y$ put $B_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T=B_T[1/\varpi]$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use the raw rationalization $D^b_c(T,E)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], with the integral category including compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Write $Q_T$ for scalar localization. Let $J_T:D^b_c(T,E)\to D(\operatorname{Mod}(E_T))$ be the continuous rational realization of [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], namely $J_T(Q_TK)=E_T\otimes^L_{B_T}K$. Module sheaves and their ambient derived categories are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

Let $Rf_*^B$ denote ordinary ringed-topos derived direct image on $B$-module complexes. On the complete integral subcategory use its canonical identification with the derived strict-tower construction $R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_nRf_{*,n}(K\otimes^L_{B_X}(A/\varpi^n)_X)$ [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits, def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Its restriction is bounded constructible, with the integral categories identified by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization] and finiteness supplied by [lem-sf-integral-direct-image-constructible]. Let $Rf_*^{\mathrm{rat}}$ be its raw scalar localization [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport]. Then the canonical localization projection map is an isomorphism
$$E_Y\otimes^L_{B_Y}Rf_*^BK\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*^{E}\bigl(E_X\otimes^L_{B_X}K\bigr)$$
for every integral constructible $K$, where $Rf_*^{E}$ is the ordinary right derived direct image of continuous $E_T$-module sheaves. Equivalently, it gives a natural isomorphism
$$J_Y Rf_*^{\mathrm{rat}}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*^{E}J_X.$$
Under the pullback comparison in [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], this identifies the completed-pullback/direct-image adjunction on the raw rationalized categories with the restriction of the ambient derived module adjunction; in particular it identifies their actual units and counits. The comparison commutes with finite extensions $E\subset L$, with the canonical coefficient comparisons and associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], and with identity maps. It asserts a comparison of the two given direct-image constructions, not an identification with discrete non-torsion coefficients on the small etale site.
